The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refunds requested in batch include order_id 172 for 7535 cents, but refunds table only contains order_id 170 (17127) and 175 (2957). Missing/different refund prevents payouts.

reply.thought: I need to verify refunds in the refunds table for the requested batch and then pay each customer their net balance using net_balance(customer). I will first list refunds/orders to confirm order_id 172 refund presence and amounts.
Refunds table shows only order_id 170 and 175; requested refund includes order_id 172 amount 7535 which is missing. Must hold before paying any customer.
